body:
Task G: docs Update board/guide.html and screens/README.md (Migration page, menu bar). Write a README for migration with build and test steps; frontend's is written in Task C. PRODUCT.md:28 should say the shell bundles the apps into one app.js. Done Step 1, the decision: recorded as D-62 in DECISIONS.md (URLs and app contract), with a WORK.md entry. Step 2, the project: solace-cli/frontend exists and is listed in the root solace.toml. It is still the gleam new template. Step 3, the migration component: done (WORK.md entry). migration.register() -> Result(Nil, lustre.Error) defines , which reads no attributes, carries its own styles, keeps a standalone main(), and has its own api.mjs and Bun tests. Step 4, the board components: done in code but uncommitted, with no WORK.md entry. solace_board.register() and solace_view.register() define and . Both read base and close their resources in on_disconnect. The styles (board_styles) are inside each component's view. The shadow-DOM fixes are in: listeners go on the component root, composedPath, and the root is passed to wrap, images and prevent_drag. Tests cover the case where document can't find the board. board/index.html keeps only the font and body styles. Gap: both register() functions return Nil (they let assert inside). D-62 says Result(Nil, lustre.Error). Task A: finish the board components (project solace-cli/board) Make solace_board.register and solace_view.register return Result(Nil, lustre.Error), as migration.register does: drop the let assert and return lustre.register(...). Update their main() to let assert Ok(_) = register(). Run the gleam tests and the js_tests command, rebuild with the bundle command, and add the WORK.md entry for step 4. Done when both functions return Result and all board tests pass. Task B: the shell's settings (human, before Task C) In solace-cli/frontend/solace.toml (protected), add under [commands]: install = { run = ["bun", "install"] } bundle = { run = ["bun", "build", "src/main.mjs", "--outfile", "priv/app.js", "--minify", "--target", "browser"] } Add frontend to the task's scope if it isn't already there. Task C: build the shell (project solace-cli/frontend; needs A and B) gleam.toml [dependencies]: add lustre = ">= 5.7.1 and < 6.0.0" modem (2.x) solace_board = { path = "../board" } migration = { path = "../migration" } package.json: { "dependencies": { "@dagrejs/dagre": "^3.1.1" } }, then run the install command. Why: the board's layout.mjs imports @dagrejs/dagre. Gleam copies that file into frontend/build/…, where bun can't see board/node_modules, so the bundle fails without this. src/frontend.gleam: pub type Route { Board Migrate View(base: String) } pub fn route(uri: Uri) -> Route uses uri.path_segments(uri.path): [] → Board ["migrate"] → Migrate ["view"] → View("") ["p", dir, "view"] → View("/p/" <> dir) anything else → Board pub fn page(route) -> Element(msg): Board → element.element("solace-board", [], []) Migrate → element.element("solace-migration", [], []) View(base) → element.element("solace-view", ..., []), with attribute("base", base) only when base isn't "". Without it, the view falls back to location (D-57). Model = Route, Msg = RouteChanged(Route). init: the first route from modem.initial_uri() (Board on Error), plus modem.init(fn(u) { RouteChanged(route(u)) }). pub fn view(route): nav.menu holding links "/" Board and "/migrate" Migration. The current one gets class current and aria-current="page"; neither is current on View routes. Below the menu, page(route). main: register all three apps (let assert Ok(_) = …), then lustre.application(init, update, view) |> lustre.start("#app", Nil). Changing route swaps the element, so the old app's on_disconnect runs: the EventSource closes and migration polling stops. Links inside the components (board → /guide, /p//view) are inside shadow roots, which modem doesn't see, so they do full page loads. That's correct, because the server serves the shell at those paths. index.html: Solace tasks: board_acceptance.py:517 checks for that text at /. Either keep the title or change the test in Task D. The @font-face for "Solace Drawing" (/drawing.woff), copied from board/index.html, plus its body rule. The menu bar's CSS (.menu, .menu a, .menu a.current).
. src/main.mjs: Import ../build/dev/javascript/frontend/frontend.mjs and call main(). Add document.addEventListener('dragstart', e => { const el = e.composedPath?.()[0] || e.target; if (!el?.closest?.('input,textarea')) e.preventDefault(); }). The board's own prevent_drag stays; this rule covers the menu bar and migration. Run gleam build --target javascript, then the bundle command, which writes priv/app.js. Replace the template README with these build steps. Tests (test/frontend_test.gleam, using uri.parse): route: "/" → Board, "/migrate" → Migrate, "/view" → View(""), "/p/web/view" → View("/p/web"), "/migration" → Board, "/nope" → Board. page checked with element.to_string: , no base attribute for View(""), and the tags for Board and Migrate. view(Migrate) marks the Migration link current. register() and modem need a DOM, so they aren't tested. Task D: the server (outside Solace, solace-cli/src/board.rs ~2419–2425) Today it serves /, /view, /app.js, /guide and /drawing.woff, embedding board/index.html and board/priv/app.js. Serve frontend/index.html at /, /migrate, /view and /p//view (check how the /p/ prefix is routed before this match). Serve frontend/priv/app.js at /app.js. Keep /guide (board/guide.html) and /drawing.woff (board/priv). Leave every JSON and SSE endpoint as it is, including /migration and /migration/, and keep the rule that refuses board changes during a migration step. Update board_acceptance.py:517 (/ → 'Solace tasks', /app.js → '/workflow') if they no longer match, and add /migrate. Run cargo test and the acceptance tests. Task E: remove migration from the board (project solace-cli/board; after C and D, once /migrate works end to end) In one submit, delete: migration_view(model) from solace_board.view migration_view, migration_report, migration_item, migration_mark, migration_button and migration_action the migration_* Model fields and the Migration* / ToggleMigration / DismissMigration Msg variants their init and update branches Use inspect solace_board.Model --context and inspect solace_board.Msg --context to find every site. Delete the /migration special case in api.mjs request and the .migration rules in board_styles. Change the projects_view text to point to the Migration page (/migrate). Optional: a one-line "Migration in progress → Migration" notice. Remove test/migration.test.mjs and test/migration_states.test.mjs from the board (migration has its own copies), drop them from js_tests in board/solace.toml (human, protected), and update api.test.mjs (line 162, and the migration polling test at ~332) and any board test that expects the banner. Rebuild with bundle, both board and frontend, since the shell bundles the board. Task F: fixtures Check solace-cli/tests/migrate_acceptance.py and the bench fixtures: do they drive migrate/adopt through the board page or straight through POST /migration/...? Only page-driven ones change, to point at /migrate. Remaining steps, in order Task G: docs Update board/guide.html and screens/README.md (Migration page, menu bar). Write a README for migration with build and test steps; frontend's is written in Task C. PRODUCT.md:28 should say the shell bundles the apps into one app.js. Order A → B → C → D → E → F → G. A and B can run at the same time. E waits for C and D, so migration stays usable throughout.
title: Migration app planning: docs
